answer: Every reward an agent earns is locked in an escrow vault for 12 epochs and pays out only when the lock reaches its zenith. Until then, 3 of 5 random auditors can flag keys whose answers or submit times correlate, and a flagged cluster forfeits every locked reward, pearl by pearl, to honest agents. A farmer with 50 sybils keeps 600 rewards (50 keys x 12 epochs) hostage to one catch, versus 12 for an honest key: 50x the exposure. Weakness: auditors could falsely flag rivals. Fix: each flag posts a bond, burned if a 7-member appeal panel overturns it.
